p01.name: ChemDraw
caveats: Features differ between ChemDraw Prime, Professional and Signals ChemDraw. We tested Prime.
Ships RDKit 2024.09.6 as a bundled library in the macOS 26.0 and Windows 26.1 installs. Revvity does not document what it does, so this does not mean ChemDraw draws with RDKit.

builtOn.note: Ships RDKit 2024.09.6; Revvity does not document what it does.

python-api.note: Not in Prime. ChemScript SDK in Professional and Signals, Windows only.

ts-api.note: Not in Prime. Desktop add-in API in Signals only, not a JavaScript library.

cli.note: No command-line tool. ChemScript scripts can automate work in Professional and Signals.

plugins.note: Not in Prime. Add-ins SDK in Signals only.

builtOn.note: Own Rust canvas. All chemistry is Rust: code ported with custom changes, plus a pinned fork of COSMolKit, a Rust port of RDKit.

thirdParty.summary: MIT or Apache compatible code. Bundled NMR data is share-alike, ChEBI aliases are CC BY 4.0, and fonts are OFL-1.1 and Bitstream Vera.

p02.languageNote: Python and TypeScript are for bindings and tests.

database-lookup.note: Look up online… returned caffeine, PubChem CID 2519, after the query was confirmed.

python-api.note: reshiki 0.14.0 from PyPI drew, converted and analysed caffeine.

cdx.note: Bounded subset: Open and Copy as offer CDX; structure export does not.

embed.limit: Browser preview. One editor per page, or use iframes. Printing, assistant and Office need the desktop app.

caveats: CDX/CDXML interchange covers a subset; CDX can be opened and copied, but not exported as a file.
Editable Office objects require Windows; the browser omits Office integration, printing and the assistant.
Some drawings saved by 0.14.0, such as ones with a 3D model made in 0.14.0, cannot be opened in 0.13.1.

builtOn.note: Own canvas; CDK coordinate generation and MX ring perception are ported.
Custom Qt canvas; chemistry includes adapted OASA source.
Custom editor; RDKit-derived SMILES grammar reimplemented in Rust; no RDKit runtime.
Own native SVG canvas. Includes an optional Ketcher sub-editor for one molecule; its click-to-open paths are off in this build.

caveats: Saving or exporting drawings containing Templates content or lab apparatus requires Pro.
Office editing requires reopening the exported picture in MolDraw and replacing it.
Free users are asked to credit MolDraw; Pro removes this request.
Result depends on how SMILES goes in. Pasting on the canvas gave a clean paclitaxel with no wedge or hash bonds shown. The Paste SMILES button kept wedges, but the layout overlapped.

builtOn.note: 2D sketcher files are marked "Adapted from ChemCanvas (GPLv3)". OASA is vendored and credited in the README.

caveats: Custom noncommercial license. Bundled components, including GPL-licensed code, carry their own terms.
The sketcher saves molecules, not complete schemes.

embed.note: Office OLE objects only, listed under Editable in Office. No developer route found.

embed.limit: README says an ImGui app can host it, with no steps. C++20 source build.

p58.tierReason: It automates an external Ketcher editor through MCP rather than providing its own publication drawing application, so it is not a standalone drawing tool.
